# notepad-api

> Note-taking backend in TypeScript: an API gateway in front of an auth service (JWT access tokens plus rotating refresh tokens) and a notes service, each with its own PostgreSQL database. It also ships an MCP server so AI agents can manage one user's notes.

All public routes are served by the gateway under `/api/v1`. Responses use the envelope `{ success, data, message }` or `{ success: false, error, errors }`. Every notes request needs `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>` and only sees the caller's own notes.

## Docs

- [OpenAPI spec](https://github.com/ayoolaniyan/notepad-api/blob/main/docs/openapi.yaml): The public HTTP contract (OpenAPI 3.1): every endpoint, request and response schema, limit and error response
- [MCP server](https://github.com/ayoolaniyan/notepad-api/blob/main/services/mcp-server/README.md): Setup, client configuration, tool reference (list_notes, get_note, create_note, update_note, delete_note), error messages, auth behaviour, limitations and evals
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/ayoolaniyan/notepad-api/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Guide for coding agents: repository layout, verified commands, API conventions and rules

## Optional

- [README](https://github.com/ayoolaniyan/notepad-api/blob/main/README.md): Full project documentation: architecture, setup, API reference, authentication design and trade-offs
- [auth-service README](https://github.com/ayoolaniyan/notepad-api/blob/main/services/auth-service/README.md): Token lifecycle, password hashing and account lockout
- [notes-service README](https://github.com/ayoolaniyan/notepad-api/blob/main/services/notes-service/README.md): Ownership checks, cursor pagination and search
